bibliography.title: Compositional Diffusion with Guided search for Long-Horizon Planning

abstract_sentences.text: Generative models have emerged as powerful tools for planning, with compositional approaches offering particular promise for modeling long-horizon task distributions by composing together local, modular generative models.

evidence.anchor: composing together local, modular generative models

abstract_sentences.text: This compositional paradigm spans diverse domains, from multi-step manipulation planning to panoramic image synthesis to long video generation.

evidence.anchor: from multi-step manipulation planning to panoramic image synthesis to long video generation

abstract_sentences.text: However, compositional generative models face a critical challenge: when local distributions are multimodal, existing composition methods average incompatible modes, producing plans that are neither locally feasible nor globally coherent.

evidence.anchor: average incompatible modes

abstract_sentences.text: We propose Compositional Diffusion with Guided Search (CDGS), which addresses this mode averaging problem by embedding search directly within the diffusion denoising process.

evidence.anchor: embedding search directly within the diffusion denoising process

abstract_sentences.text: Our method explores diverse combinations of local modes through population-based sampling, enforces global consistency through iterative resampling between overlapping segments, and prunes infeasible candidates using likelihood-based filtering.

evidence.anchor: population-based sampling; iterative resampling; likelihood-based filtering

abstract_sentences.text: CDGS matches oracle performance on seven robot manipulation tasks, outperforming baselines that lack compositionality or require long-horizon training data.

evidence.anchor: matches oracle performance on seven robot manipulation tasks

abstract_sentences.text: The approach generalizes across domains, enabling coherent text-guided panoramic images and long videos through effective local-to-global message passing.

evidence.anchor: generalizes across domains
More details: https://cdgsearch.github.io/

introduction_moves.current_answer: 机器人动作、panorama 和 video 都要求跨 extended horizons 保持一致。

introduction_moves.previous_question: 现有方法如何学习长序列？
introduction_moves.current_answer: full-sequence data 昂贵，monolithic models 超出 training horizons 后失效；composition 可用短 horizon local distributions。

introduction_moves.previous_question: 如何在 denoising 中导航模式组合？
introduction_moves.current_answer: CDGS 将 guided search 放入每个 diffusion timestep，以 iterative resampling 提供 message passing，以 likelihood-based pruning 去除不一致候选。
introduction_moves.next_hook: 两组件如何形式化并跨域验证？

final_judgment.single_storyline: 短 horizon local diffusion models 在 multimodal overlaps 上会 mode-average；CDGS 把 population search 放进每个 denoising step，用 resampling 传播 overlap 信息、用 DDIM-curvature ranking/pruning 排除局部不一致候选，从而在不使用 long-horizon training data 的情况下寻找长计划。证据：pp.2、4–6。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Figures 1/3/5 的问题与失败直觉、Eq. (1)–(5)、Algorithms 1–2、B/K/U、任务与 horizon、trial/prompt 分母、主要模型与 Tables 1–5 数值，以及 video aesthetic tradeoff。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: App. A/B/D/E/F/H/J/K 被引用于 panorama/video、curvature、TAMP、感知和超参数，但实际 appendix/supplementary 不在供应 PDF；这损害实现层面的自足性。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 3 用同一 1D domain 并排展示 naive→resampling→pruning；Figure 4 把两组件置于同一 denoising loop；Table 3 按 task-information privilege 分层，Figure 5 同时给失败案例与 B×U scaling。
final_judgment.largest_gap: Eq. (5) 的 J 符号方向与“minimize/high J”文字冲突；另无 theorem/proof、feasibility calibration、compute-normalized search comparison、完整 appendix 或独立 resampling/pruning 因子实验。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 凡用代理分数做生成时搜索／筛选，都应在同一处明确代理方向、排序操作、采样权重和消融，并用可观测失败案例验证代理对应目标性质。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 若目标属性无法由 local likelihood/curvature 代理观测，或排序方向未形式化，只能写诊断性关联，不能写 feasibility guarantee；本文 J 方向冲突正是该边界。
